messages.author: 6ecf433d477085ba
messages.subject: Re: Eliminate title on guild
parts:
On Thursday, January 24, 2013 4:38:24 PM UTC-5, Troy S wrote:
I'm trying to eliminate the word drug in the guide for the following plot.  I read the manual but not having much luck.

set.seed(123)
y=data.frame(t=runif(100, 1, 100), fraction=sort(runif(100)),
  drug=sample(letters[1:2], 100, replace=T))
print(ggplot(y, aes(t, fraction, linetype=drug))
+geom_step()
+scale_x_continuous("Days",limits=c(0,168))
+scale_y_continuous("Percent", limits=c(0,1), labels=percent)
+guides(col=guide_legend(title=NULL))
)

messages.author: e01d780396d5e3f0
messages.subject: Re: Eliminate title on guild
parts:
To remove word drug use the following code:

theme(legend.title=element_blank())

This will remove the title of the legend.

ggplot(y, aes(t, fraction, linetype=drug))+
      geom_step()+
      scale_x_continuous("Days",limits=c(0,168))+

On Fri, Jan 25, 2013 at 1:19 PM, Roman Luštrik <roman....@gmail.com> wrote:
Add

labs(linetype = "")

Cheers,
Roman
